svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Make two, the same. Cut 60 mm lengths of 50 x 50 x 3 angle; square

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg (against the post): two 5.5 mm holes at mid-length (30 mm),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 and 40 mm up from the underside of the flat leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg (on the board): two 4.5 mm holes, 26.5 mm out from the back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the upright leg, 10 and 50 mm along the length.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two angles clamped together so the holes match, then

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersink the flat-leg holes lightly for the screw heads.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the back of the upright leg sits flat on a side face of the post,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the flat leg points away from the post and sits flat on the board.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M5 bolts go through both angles and the post (step 1).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the two angles stand square and level on a flat bench.
